+1 for a good story. I really enjoyed it.

If I could I'd give you another +1 for getting the lockpicking right just because that's such a rare thing in fiction. You even got the most common reaction to a broken pick right.

item.content:encoded: The note is one of the best examples of alien thought processes shoehorned into the frail structure of English I've yet seen. So many messages of this type are merely strange—this succeeds in being truly alien while still maintaining a sufficient semblance of meaning.

I assume he'll just never sleep. I don't think he's one to back down from a challenge.

Anyway, I am very interested to see where this goes. Consider me hooked and ready for the next 27 installments. Hopefully you don't let drowsiness impede the quality.
